description: This source file defines a convention class for ASP.NET Core MVC that labels controllers with a group name based on their route attribute, specifically extracting the API version from the route pattern.

classes.name: GroupByApiRootConvention
classes.description: Implements IControllerModelConvention to assign API group names based on route templates.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Sets the ApiExplorer.GroupName property for a controller based on the first segment of its route attribute, indicating API versioning.
